title: The fractal requirements machine: module-local registries on top of the base machine
summary: The base requirements machine keeps every obligation in one project-wide registry; this extension turns any module folder into a machine of its own — its own registry, tests and coverage-script copy, with the folder name as the ID prefix, so root and module IDs can never collide and a module can be extracted with its git history. A root manifest plus a five-invariant aggregator keep the root aware, and about a week of real work on top showed the growth and the speculative research landing in the module while the root stayed clean. Applies on top of the 2026-09-18 requirements-machine dump; every file is inlined.
